profile_text.body:
According to its website, AeroVironment describes itself as a manufacturer of Unmanned Aircraft Systems, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, Loitering Munition Systems, and Unmanned Ground Vehicles used for surveillance and reconnaissance by the United States Military, U.S. allies, and commercial industries. The company also says it manufactures High-Altitude Pseudo-Satellites.

The company's MacCready Works group is presented as its advanced development unit, where engineers, roboticists, and AI researchers design next-generation autonomous systems across air, land, and sea. The group is said to follow the MacCready Method: build fast, test relentlessly, deploy advantage, inspired by Dr. Paul B. MacCready, Jr.

AeroVironment is a for-profit public company headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, trading as AVAV, with SEC CIK number 0001368622. Its public record includes 152 legal exposure entries in Virginia and no listed litigation cases.
